name: mimisbrunnr
description: Mímisbrunnr — persistent AI context-memory skills. Get/set durability for agent knowledge, braindump capture, recall-feedback tuning, dossier composition, baseline bootstrapping, session binding, and Understanding transfer.

plugins.name: mimisbrunnr
plugins.description: The seven Mímisbrunnr skills: odin-context-memory (get/set write authority), vitsmunir-dump (braindump capture), muninn-recall-feedback (retrieval health queries), understanding (load/import/export/session-dump), saga-dossier (read-only cited dossier), ymir-bootstrap (baseline bootstrap), and heimdallr-find-session-metadata (session binding).

plugins.name: ai-understanding
plugins.description: Export session knowledge as transferable Understandings; import, publish and consume them across workspaces (upstream smooth-devex-template skill with accepted local divergences).
